verdict.rationale: Whether user data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question for an MCP platform that handles user data, but the evidence pack has no training opt-out or no-training policy. Credential encryption and not exposing credentials to AI models, along with revocable account access, are adjacent security controls, not protection against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
